text:
The sea rocks its thousands of waves,

divine.

Hearing the loving seas,

I rock my child.

The wandering wind in the night

rocks the wheat.

Hearing the loving winds,

I rock my child.

God the Father rocks his thousands of worlds

without a sound.

Feeling his hand in the darkness,

I rock my child.

translation.title: The Sea Rocks Its Thousands of Waves…
translation.editorial_note: Repeated rock preserves the lullaby's physical rhythm and its widening movement from cradle to cosmos.
